page: OVHcloud t2-le-180 is an x86_64 architecture server within the Cloud GPU family, running on a KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 6226R processor operating at 2.9 GHz with 60 dedicated physical cores and 60 vCPUs, utilizing a single thread per core configuration. The system is equipped with 180.0 GB of RAM, providing 3.0 GB of memory per core. For acceleration, the server integrates four NVIDIA Volta V100S GPUs, delivering a total of 128 GB of VRAM. Local storage consists of a 500 GB NVMe SSD, and network connectivity is supported by a 10 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong capabilities in multi-threaded and parallel processing workloads. The server achieves strong results in stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression, alongside a strong PassMark memory score. While single-core performance metrics, such as Geekbench single-core and stress-ng single-core, fall into the average tier, the multi-GPU setup excels in machine learning tasks. LLM inference speeds are highly competitive, reaching top-tier performance for prompt processing and text generation across small, medium, and large models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the t2-le-180 offers a dense allocation of four dedicated enterprise GPUs and 60 physical CPU cores, making it a highly resource-dense option for parallel computing without the overhead of hyperthreading. The hardware profile is optimized for workloads requiring massive parallel processing power, such as large language model inference, deep learning training, ray tracing, and complex multi-threaded scientific simulations.
